baseline.name: Compare every dictionary word with the stream suffix
baseline.approach: For each query, test each word's characters against the current stream ending.
baseline.time: O(S) worst case per query, S total dictionary characters

archived.name: Reversed-word trie
archived.time: O(P+S) build; O(L) per query, L longest word
archived.space: Fixed P=400005 trie nodes and Q=40005 stream characters

why: Shared reversed prefixes let one backward stream walk test many dictionary suffixes together.
quantitative_comparison: A query follows at most L trie edges rather than comparing up to S dictionary characters in the stated baseline. Build cost and the preallocated P-node memory must be included; no measured speedup or exact query savings are known.
tradeoffs: Only lowercase a..z and bounded total nodes/queries are supported. Fixed allocation can be wasteful for small dictionaries, and capacity/allocation failures are unchecked.
evidence_basis: Static trie path bound and allocated capacities versus per-word suffix checks; no benchmark.
